Intersect exact 3D construction cell sets with all 50 reserve structure starts; retain the three frozen default-deny cores; resolve the absent east-igloo condition; and freeze reviewed hash-bound positive buffers and separately owned access.

Use the frozen full-height baseline to census every future exact excavation/fill influence volume; assign owners and define groundwater, drainage, catchments, retaining works, sumps, discharges, snowmelt treatment, and a no-unintended-diversion acceptance test.

Bidirectional route, media, rollback, and post-state QA remain R01 acceptance evidence under G16-G19 and cannot satisfy D02/D05/D06 or G02.
